seo_description: High school scholarships in District of Columbia, USA: compare award ranges, deadlines, and requirements, then apply on official program pages.
intro: Trying to find District of Columbia scholarships for high school students in the USA usually means sorting through programs that look similar at first glance but differ in who qualifies, what they ask for, and when you need to apply. This filtered view brings together a focused set of listings tied to the District of Columbia and the high school level, with examples spanning education, community, STEM, humanities, and law-related interests. Awards vary by listing, and official pages should be checked to confirm current amounts, eligibility details, and application steps. Deadlines also differ across these rows, with some appearing soon, so it makes sense to compare dates early. Requirements are mixed as well: some listings may be lighter-touch, while others can ask for more materials, including essays.
